jp:
ゲームを　続けますか？
　{KN}
en: Continue the game?{KN}

How to Play the Treasure Hunt Game{KP}Search the house for hidden money until you have 100 ryo!{KP}Stand in front of anything that catches your eye and press the Circle button to check it!{KP}Wicker chests, buckets, rocks, alcoves... money's hidden in all sorts of places!{KP}Though now and then, someone nasty might pop out!{KP}Once you have 100 ryo, go back to the starting point!{KP}Hold the X button while running to speed up!{KP}Now then, go this way, and go that way!{KP}No rushing, no panicking... but hurry uuup!
